text:
maya: heads up — vendor is proposing a split consignment for the bulk h100 order to avoid a single customs hold. asks if we can accept staggered delivery and separate RMA queues
alex: can we absorb split arrivals in SFO + FRA depots? capacity looks tight in SFO this week
lia: SFO has 6 bays free Tue-Thu, but FR depot needs extra staff for serial reconciliation; added a headcount request to ops runbook
vincent: pricing update from vendor — +3% if we do split shipments vs +7% for consolidated with priority air. they also want 30% prepayment on first consignment
maya: tag @procurement — is prepayment acceptable? also need holdback on invoice until serial audit done
alex: procurement (kaitlyn) okayed 20% prepay only, remainder on delivery acceptance. we'll push for holdback clause in contract
lia: on RMA side — we need separate AWB tracking per consignment and a unified manifest for depot reconciliation. otherwise returns will be painful
ops-bot: NOTE: created ticket OPS-4221 for SFO depot staffing and manifest template uploaded at https://intranet.redwood/ops/manifests/consignment-v2
vincent: vendor suggested mixing air + sea for second consignment to hit budget. lead time estimates: consignment1 air 5-7d, consignment2 sea 21-28d
maya: risk: if consignment1 has DOA units and vendor delays RMA for consignment2, we could have a shortage for Dedicated customers. propose holdback + expedited RMA SLA in contract
alex: agree. also request vendor provide spare pool of 5 units (on loan) for 30 days pending replacements — reduces customer impact
lia: operational checklist I need from vendor:
```
- AWB per unit serial mapping
- separate customs invoice for each consignment
- RMA contact and SLA for DOA
- insured value and claims process
```
vincent: vendor replied with draft manifest XLS, wants confirmation on customs HS codes and tariff class. they listed HS 8471.70 but our broker flagged as question
maya: brokerage note — confirm HS 8471.70 is correct for accelerators, provide invoice description "GPU accelerator for compute" to avoid miscoding
alex: who is our broker contact in EU? lia: it's "AtlasBroker Ltd" — lia, can you start the customs pre-clearance?
lia: on it. I'll start pre-clearance and ask AtlasBroker to validate HS and insurance values. ETA 24h for reply
ops-bot: REMINDER: procurement holdback template set to 10% by default — procurement must approve higher holdback. See https://intranet.redwood/finance/holdbacks
maya: ok next steps:
- kaitlyn/procurement to confirm prepay % and holdback
- lia to validate HS codes & start pre-clearance
- vendor to provide AWB per serial & spare pool confirmation
- legal to add expedited RMA SLA + invoice holdback clause
let's reconvene after AtlasBroker reply, thanks :thumbsup:
